notes: Adds a new preprocessing capability for using existing datasets.
Adds a new ordered fallback behavior for unsupported encoding and quality combinations.
Extends the accepted configuration syntax with inline comments.
Adds an explicit channel-selection parameter that does not currently exist.
Changes the public return contract to expose an additional p-value.
Adds a new command-line exclusion mode.
Adds a new CSV export capability for registration data.
Export currently loses meaningful kerning group-name information that should be preserved.
Requests restoration of an existing game feature broken by an upstream event change.
Adds selection of a specific Wikipedia page section.
A normal in-place expression operation creates an invalid self-reference instead of the expected sum.
Introduces a specific catchable evaluation-error API and optional constraint details.
Extends post-processing to support the new SamplerV2 result interface.
Adds a new download or processing date metadata field.
Requests a typing-only correction with no runtime task-policy method.
A supported multi-repeat OR query consistently fails at runtime.
A documented timeline query raises an internal KeyError instead of returning its result.
A supported flag combination fails with repository lookup and cleanup errors.
The only concrete request is adding integration-test coverage.
Adds a convenient API for loading default columns plus requested additions.
Adds Options.headless as a public configuration path while centralizing existing browser configuration.
The documented quick-start flow fails instead of starting the browser.
Adds a new rule option for excluding specified values.
Changes the user-visible rules grammar and escaping contract.
Implements the missing parser and AST-building capability.
Restores conformance by rejecting invalid PID cardinalities and filling the allowed omitted form.
An existing credentials accessor raises on a present field instead of returning its data.
The parser rejects a standards-defined TZID form that its recurrence interface should accept.
Adds missing NBA statistics fields already exposed for other sports.
Existing OIDC behavior cannot honor the standard scope-to-claims contract.
An invalidated refresh token returns an internal 500 instead of the required 401 response.
Adds parsing support for a currently unsupported Nexus representation.
Combines restoration of failing filename and accent cases with new metadata and date-format capabilities.
A misleading negative-time log should accurately report that synchronization is disabled.
Adds mime-type indexing to the OneDrive connector output.
An editor name change fails to update the corresponding unfocused split tab.
A timer API change broke the documented IsRunning call on current master.
Adds a new supported deployment architecture and image variants.
Existing enum-to-ctypes behavior regressed under Python 3.11 type enforcement.
An internal parameter name prevents callers from passing a common valid request_id argument.
Adds more descriptive generated commit-message behavior.
Implements CRUD operations that are currently missing from the authorizations API.
Requests investigation of an API design followed by easier integrator access as a new public capability.
The cargo generator crashes on a valid lock file containing a git dependency.
A fresh sketch with no history triggers an unhandled None access.
Extends returned hub user information with auth_state.
A global calendar option is rejected solely because it follows the subcommand.
An existing class view renders a skeleton but omits its instances.
Adds an optional programmatic studio_token argument.
The concrete outcome is test coverage only.
Adds a new date-based file sorting mode.
Adds a UI and database operation for permanently deleting unauthorized users.
Adds a backward-compatible shorthand decorator API.
Java generation maps date slots to String because of erroneous type-map keys.
Defines a new explicit warning and strict-error contract for rules without usable preconditions.
Adds a source field to storage and the rank service API.
Changing mobile theme causes an existing graph to disappear.
A basic app-run command crashes when an optional external executable is absent.
Changes the internal AST representation of subscript expressions without requesting a new observable outcome.
Adds a new compound-overlap checking function for self-avoiding construction.
Adds timestamp data or a new dataframe input representation to OHLCV.
Introduces a new structured error and traceback logging contract.
Insufficient cache identity returns the wrong outlook for valid requests.
Adds startup from a figure object or figure path.
Command resolution incorrectly selects a directory instead of the later executable on PATH.
Separates daemon and batch behavior while restructuring the daemon-client boundary.
Extends export to include multiple actively referenced entity versions.
Adds actor identity to the restore audit record.
Generated polygon whitespace is incompatible with a consumer and the stated format contract.
The threaded debugger displays an unrelated or stale request object.
Reworks context propagation specifically to remove contextvar overhead while preserving compatible dispatch.
Adds handling for arrays of strings, a representation intentionally unsupported today.
Adds dependency detection and an installation guidance state to the tools page.
Version 3.6 regressed Retry-After handling and now retries too early or not at all.
A broken admin tree produces an uninformative generic error instead of actionable validation.
The concrete requested artifact is unit-test coverage for escaping behavior.
Adds parsing support for a currently unsupported file type.
Iterating a failed proxy future recurses forever instead of raising its underlying exception.
Adds parameterized command-line input to the language runtime.
Replaces two filename settings with a new placeholder-capable template contract.
Adds a family of event-time transformations and metadata correlation behavior.
Adds a set-domain API and command to FAIR.
Adds selective variable loading from MAT files.
Adds an environment-controlled force-enable mode for non-TTY execution.
Remix title parsing incorrectly invents an additional guest artist.
Changes the public observation tensor layout to align with other environments.
Replaces ad-hoc configuration checks with a modular validator while retaining validation purpose.
Adds a command argument for overriding recipe variables.
Adds a coprime-detection algorithm as a new library function.
The concrete request is removal of warnings from the unit-test run.
Extends protocol negotiation with separate feature state and connect-time requirements.
Long-lived clients keep expired exec credentials instead of refreshing them.
Adds the convenience load_config API available in the related client.
Requests removal of incorrect case-dependent variable sorting.
Adds a sequence-length option to the Newick conversion API.
Migrates rigid slug syncing to a reusable controller while adding multi-target, check, and debounce behavior.
The chooser exposes a meaningless locale filter when internationalization is disabled.
The OVA build workflow fails because a required executable is absent from its environment.
Ports existing OVA fixes into the new generation path to restore Vagrant behavior.
Adds a native count query to the existing query API.
